"""OCSF-to-OpenSearch adapter boundary; initial semantic TDD stub.

No local event matcher belongs here. Conversion is not OpenSearch execution.
"""

from sigma.collection import SigmaCollection


def convert_rule(text: str) -> list[str]:
    """Parse one valid Sigma rule; query generation is intentionally pending."""
    collection = SigmaCollection.from_yaml(text, collect_errors=False)
    if len(collection.rules) != 1:
        raise ValueError("exactly one Sigma rule is required")
    return []

"""The first RED compares an adapter with the actual released backend."""

import unittest

from sigma.backends.opensearch import OpensearchLuceneBackend
from sigma.collection import SigmaCollection
from sigma.processing.pipeline import ProcessingItem, ProcessingPipeline
from sigma.processing.transformations.values import CaseTransformation

from detect.sigma.convert import convert_rule


REFERENCE_RULE = """title: Synthetic Azure Role Assignment Action
id: 8ce13e27-4f0d-5d85-a22d-c53c1726b629
status: experimental
description: Synthetic conversion contract, not live detection evidence.
author: Warden
date: 2026-10-25
logsource:
  product: azure
  service: activity
detection:
  selection:
    class_uid: 6003
    metadata.product.name: Azure Activity Log
    api.operation: Microsoft.Authorization/roleAssignments/write
  condition: selection
level: medium
"""


class AdapterRedTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_returns_backend_reference(self):
        reference = OpensearchLuceneBackend(
            ProcessingPipeline(
                items=[ProcessingItem(transformation=CaseTransformation(method="lower"))]
            ),
            collect_errors=False,
        ).convert(SigmaCollection.from_yaml(REFERENCE_RULE, collect_errors=False))
        self.assertEqual(len(reference), 1, "real backend must emit one query")
        self.assertIsInstance(reference[0], str)
        self.assertTrue(reference[0].strip(), "reference query cannot be empty")
        self.assertEqual(convert_rule(REFERENCE_RULE), reference)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

"""Tag-derived reporting boundary; initial semantic TDD stub.

Fixtures, conversion, indexed queries and live detection are separate evidence.
"""


def summarize_rules(rules: list[dict]) -> dict:
    """Return a nonempty report structure; actual aggregation is pending."""
    if not rules:
        raise ValueError("coverage input cannot be empty")
    return {
        "rule_count": 0,
        "tagged_rule_count": 0,
        "unassigned_rule_count": 0,
        "technique_count": 0,
        "rules": [],
        "techniques": [],
    }
